semantic_label: bake row probe: compute the four lengths, then fail on the first of eleven budget gates in a fixed order

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x44
abi.return_contract: a byte in AL; MOV AL,0x1 on success and XOR AL,AL on the single failure site, so only the low byte is an answer

instruction_list: compute the group length as the four byte distance between row + 0x9c and row + 0x98 divided by 0x8c
compute the span length as the four byte distance between row + 0xb0 and row + 0xac shifted right by two
compute the link length as the four byte distance between row + 0xec and row + 0xe8 shifted right by two
compute the seat length as the four byte distance between row + 0x118 and row + 0x114 divided by 0x38
all four lengths are computed before the first dispatch
probe the descriptor {0xabb455b7, 10} with the width eight
probe the group length with the width 0x10
call the budget gate 0x004bf0a0 with owner, row + 0x18 and 0x80

probe row + 0x98 with group * 0x8c, row + 0xac with spans << 2, row + 0xc0 with spans, row + 0xd4 with links << 2, row + 0xe8 with links << 2, row + 0xfc with links << 2, row + 0x110 with four and row + 0x114 with seats * 0x38
every probe is a stdcall through the vtable slot +0x38 with two words and no receiver, so the callee releases the eight bytes and the caller emits no stack adjustment
every failure branches to one site that clears AL, so the first failure in the order above decides the result
